rules.statement: A company carrying on business through an agent in Ceylon is considered to be resident within the Island for the purpose of prescription.
rules.supporting_quote: "For as Cotton L. J. said in Erichsen Cash,1 whenever a foreigner either by himself or through a representative in this country "habitually does and contracts to do a thing capable of producing profit, and for the purpose of producing profits he carries on a trade or business.""
